an4.123:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.123:1.4: So tad assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.123:1.5: tattha ṭhito tad-adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.123:1.7: tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayaṃ pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pittivisayam pi gacchati.
an4.123:1.8: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an4.123:1.9: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 2.
an4.123:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādo cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.123:2.2: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.123:2.3: tattha ṭhito tad-adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.123:2.4: Ābhassarānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ dve kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an4.123:2.5: tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pittivisayam pi gacchati.
an4.123:2.6: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an4.123:2.7: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 3.
an4.123:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. Yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.123:3.2: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.123:3.3: tattha ṭhito tad-adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.123:3.4: Subhakiṇhānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ cattāro kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an4.123:3.7: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 4.
an4.123:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsati-parisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.123:4.2: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.123:4.3: tattha ṭhito tad-adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Vehapphalānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.123:4.4: Vehapphalānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ pañca kappasatāni āyuppamāṇaṃ,
an4.123:4.7: Ayaṃ bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati.
an4.123:4.8: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 124.1 1.
